findings.title: Hub decides on a start-up copy of myelin.yaml: promote into a Domain added by `myelin add-domain` is refused (422) and a Settings save writes the stale Domain list back
findings.property: P1_NoStaleDecision (and P2_NoLostDomain via the stale cache)
findings.story: The Hub loads myelin.yaml once in HubService.open()/reload(). Brian runs `myelin add-domain D4` in a terminal; the file now lists D4 and 10_Domains/D4/_MOC.md exists. In the running Hub, GET /api/domains still omits D4, promoting a draft into D4 fails with 422 "domain 'D4' is not configured", and clicking Save on the Settings page sends back the stale `current` so D4 disappears from myelin.yaml while its folder stays (doctor: unregistered domain). Only a restart synchronised the Hub.

fix.summary: HubService keeps the bytes of myelin.yaml it loaded (_config_bytes) and, before any decision (`_v()`, `ready`), re-reads the file and calls reload() when the bytes differ (`_reload_if_changed`, double-checked under _write_lock). packs()/save_pack use ready/_v() instead of the raw cache. No API change; reload only when the file changed.

findings.title: PUT /api/settings has no version check: a Domain added between the Settings page's GET and PUT is dropped (window = one round trip after F1; before F1 the whole Hub lifetime)
findings.story: Settings.tsx save() fetches `current` then PUTs `{...current, level, mcp, commons}`. If `myelin add-domain` writes the file between these two requests, save_settings validates and writes the old Domain list: the new Domain's folder exists but the Domain is gone from myelin.yaml.

fix.summary: PROPOSED (HITL — public API): GET /api/settings returns `version` (sha256 of myelin.yaml bytes / ETag); PUT carries `If-Match`/`base_version`; mismatch -> 412 and Settings.tsx re-fetches and retries. Alternative server-only guard: refuse a PUT that drops a Domain whose 10_Domains/<D>/ exists. Modelled as the `IfMatch` toggle: MC.cfg passes with it, MC_partial.cfg fails without it.

findings.title: CLI `myelin add-domain` (and `myelin obsidian setup`) commits the whole working tree with `git add -A`: unrelated user files land in the `[myelin:add-domain]` commit, and an unfinished user note makes the Vault pre-commit device refuse add-domain's own commit
findings.property: ADR-0009 §4 (docs/adr/0009-hub-write-policy.md:11): staging is limited to touched paths; unrelated user changes never mix into a commit
findings.story: packages/myelin-cli/src/myelin_cli/app.py:105 `_git_commit_vault` stages with `git add -A` for every caller. Case A: a user's scratch file 30_Resources/wip-notes.txt is recorded under `[myelin:add-domain] D2`. Case B: a frontmatter-less WIP note is staged too, `myelin doctor --staged` (pre-commit hook) rejects it, and add-domain prints `(git commit 생략 …)` leaving its own 7 changes uncommitted. The Hub's `_stage()` (service.py:292-301) already does this correctly.

fix.summary: PROPOSED (not applied — design choice: `init` intentionally stages the whole scaffold): give `_git_commit_vault(root, message, paths=None)` a `paths` parameter; `add-domain` and `obsidian setup` pass their `touched` lists and the helper runs `git add -- <paths>` (mirroring HubService._stage); `init` keeps `-A`. Add a CLI test asserting `git show --name-only HEAD` == touched.
